description: Signing firewall for EIP-3009 / x402 authorizations. Call BEFORE signing, every time. Returns SIGN or DONT_SIGN with machine-readable reasons. A DONT_SIGN is a stop, not a suggestion; a SIGN is evidence, not an instruction — the caller's own policy still decides. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

now.description: Optional: pin evaluation time, unix seconds

value.description: Amount in the token's smallest unit, as a string

name: mad_check_authorization
